items.title: Two-way voice notes
items.mechanism: Voxtral transcribes, answers and sends a playable voice note
items.benefit: Continue a recent conversation in audio
evidence: Source at 0beef5323c6adecfd3467f138cb0f1e6462d8331

qualifications: Mistral API key and model quota required.
Recent conversation context expires and clears on restart.

items.mechanism: Leave transcription open, expose the error and accept a new caller turn

qualifications: Focused WebSocket regression; illustration is not a recording of an injected real-provider failure.

items.title: Booking correction and date integrity

items.mechanism: Preserve unchanged details, submit the replacement and remove the predecessor
